dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... Is this the Vourukasha Oasis? It has a very... unique beauty.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is this a letter from Julien? Let Paimon have a look...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "It's still an amateur piece, but I would like to dedicate this painting to you, my friends. There are a great many more views and vistas that remain to be drawn. If fate will have it, we shall meet again."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like he's gone... Hopefully things'll go well for him in the future! And that he doesn't get lost again...

dialogues.speaker: Julien's Letter
dialogues.text: "It's still an amateur piece, but I would like to dedicate this painting to you, my friends. There are a great many more views and vistas that remain to be drawn. If fate will have it, we shall meet again."

dialogues.speaker: Julien
dialogues.text: There's no need to overthink, right? I should just draw whatever I see...
